thread:
maria: Quick canary update — we ran the new 'pluck coalescer' + small-batcher combo on the t4 pool for 72h at 10% traffic. High-level: p50 down ~22% (45ms -> 35ms), p95 down ~18%, p99 down ~12%. Cost per 1M tokens ~14% lower.

sam: Hell yeah. Any functional regressions observed?

maria: No functional regressions surfaced in canary traffic. We did see one pattern on long-context (>2048 tokens) workloads: p95 for those flows increased ~5% on a specific rlhf-derived model.

oliver: Can you share the dashboard/objective links? Want to scan traces.

maria: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/runtime/rollouts/2177777777  (canary snapshot + traces)

qa-bot: Regression note: increased tail for long-context found in 14 sessions, correlated to coalescer merging some prefix frames. Marked as caution.

maria: Root cause looks like the coalescer occasionally holds tiny prefix groups together which helps short requests but adds serialization for very long sequences. Fixes/options: 1) set coalescer.short_threshold=2048 to bypass for long contexts, 2) route long-seq model variants to default coalescer, 3) tweak small-batcher.max_batch to 8 for those paths.

infra-bot: Canary rollout metric snapshot: 
- traffic: 10%
- duration: 72h
- p50 change: -22%
- p95 change: -18%
- p99 change: -12%
- cost delta: -14% per 1M tokens
- errors: 0.02% (unchanged)

sam: Sounds like a net win if we gate the long-context path. Proposal: ramp to 50% tomorrow with long-context bypass enabled, monitor p99 and error rate for 6h windows, then 100% Wednesday if stable.

oliver: I'll update the rollout playbook and add the bypass toggle and an auto-rollback rule on p99 > baseline + 10% for 15m.

maria: Plan for knobs (to be pushed to config service):
```
coalescer.mode=pluck
coalescer.short_threshold=2048
batcher.max_batch=12
coalescer.merge_timeout_ms=8
```
We'll start with batcher.max_batch=12 at 50% traffic.

sam: Who owns smoke tests for overnight? I can take the 1am->5am window.

maria: awesome — assigned to @sam. oliver will monitor trace heatmap, i'll watch cost dashboards. qa-bot will run regression harness against the rlhf model set.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 50% -> 10:00 UTC tomorrow; auto-ramp to 100% if p99 stays within thresholds for 6 consecutive 15m windows.

maria: TL;DR: 'pluck coalescer' + small-batcher reduces median latency significantly and saves ~14% token cost. Bypass for >2048 token flows to avoid a small tail regression. Rolling to 50% tomorrow, full ramp next week if stable. :tada:

sam: :thumbsup:

oliver: Noted. Will post a short postmortem-style doc if anything odd shows up during the ramp.

maria: Thanks team — I'll post a final summary once we hit 100% or hit a rollback.
